name: EF88
description:
The 'Enhanced F88' is an Nomenslandian adopted variant of the UAR. It is a lighter weighing upgrade of the F88.
High fire rate with high damage up close while remaining reliable for ranged combat.

Model submitted by Rialag.

Tri Laser.info:
A triple laser pointer.
Improves hipfire damping and decreases your crosshair size & spread rate.

Canted Animu Sight.info:
Adds an additional Anti at 45째 on the sidelines supporting you in the heat of battle, ready to help when she's needed!

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

Green Laser.info:
A large tactical green laser that helps improve gun stability.

20% less gun sway

Flashlight.info: A rugged, heavy-duty, high-powered flashlight that lights up dark environments. Don't leave home without one.

Canted Acog Scope.info:
Adds an additional Acog scope at 45째 for those moments you really just need a second scope.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

Blue Laser.info:
A tactical blue laser designed to improve target acquisition speeds.

Improves aiming speed by 7%.

Yellow Laser.info: A yellow-colored laser with a built-in IR illuminator. Improves weapon equip & unequip speeds, and slightly improves weapon sway.

Laser.info:
A red colored laser pointer.
Improves your gun transition speed when you start and stop sprinting.

Ballistics Tracker.info:
A StyLiS-branded phone mount. It's duct-taped to the side of your weapon. Somehow the phone can calculate the perfect position for a headshot.
Unbalances the weapon. Tracks targets within a small radius while aiming. Only you can see the targeting dots.

Unfortunately, the always-on targeting system makes it harder to conceal your own presence: your minimap hide range with suppressors is increased (worsened) by 30 studs, and your minimap pings last 30% longer.

Canted Furro Sight.info:
Adds awn addwitional fuwwwy at 45째 on the sidewines suwppowting u in the heat of battwe, weady to hewp when he's needed! OwO

Pwess T to toggwe between optics and these sights.

Canted Iron Sight.info:
Adds an additional set of iron sights at 45째, allowing users to quickly switch from a high powered optic to iron sights for favorable performance in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

Canted Delta Sight.info:
Adds an additional delta sight at 45째 for fast and clean target acquisition in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

AUG Burst Group.info:
Changes the trigger grouping of your UAR favoring a 3-round burst over full auto.
Slightly raises headshot and torso damage while also slightly reducing recoil.

R2 Suppressor.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

Compensator.info:
A compensating muzzle device.
40% less horizontal recoil variance
15% more vertical muzzle kick and variance
25% more muzzle climb
Slightly worse hipfire spread and stability.

Muzzle Booster.info:
8% RPM increase.
Increases the rate of fire by increasing recoil forces, but that also makes the recoil higher in general. Reduced suppression.

Loudener.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

Flash Hider.info:
Eliminates the muzzle flash from unburnt propellants while firing by cooling and dispersing burning gases that exit the muzzle.

Improves visual recoil by 20%, hides the gun's flash, and provides a modest 60 stud minimap masking range.
Your minimap marker also fades 40% faster.
Very slightly improves hipfire stability.

PBS-4 Suppressor.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

X-Ring.info:
Unlike other muzzle attachments, this unusual device improves rotational recoil and gun displacement. Slightly higher felt camera recoil and a little less effective with hipfire.
Not very effective at blowing up moon-sized battlestations.

Oil Filter.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

Muffler.info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and reduce RPM by 10%.

T-Brake.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.

Short Barrel (AR).info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

Suppressor.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

Long Barrel (AR).info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

Muzzle Brake.info:
A standard muzzle device which reduces vertical recoil climb by dispersing muzzle gases horizontally.

40% reduction in vertical kick
15% increase to vertical stability
15% less vertical rotational recoil
20% less muzzle climb

15% more horizontal recoil variance

ARS Suppressor.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

Halbek Device.info: A device designed to mitigate recoil on the FAL platform, but for some reason it functionally 'inverts' recoil here! The halbek device causes your gun to recoil in a downwards manner to reduce muzzle climb. However its performance heavily depends on the gun.

PBS-1 Suppressor.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

Long Barrel (DMR).info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and handling speeds. Worse movement.

Potato Grip.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

Green Laser.info:
A large tactical green laser that helps improve gun stability.

20% less gun sway

Flashlight.info: A rugged, heavy-duty, high-powered flashlight that lights up dark environments. Don't leave home without one.

Romanian Grip.info:
A sturdy tactical foregrip that improves gun stability and vertical camera recoil but has worse horizontal recoil control, handling and mobility while aiming.

[GAIN]
-20% Translation recoil.
-10% Vertical camera body (X) recoil.
-10% Vertical camera Body (X) recoil climb.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-20% Idle & Walk sway.
-25% Scope sway.

[LOSS]
+10% Horizontal camera body (Y) recoil.
-5% Walk speed while aiming.
-10% Aiming/Equipping/Sprinting transition speeds.

Folding Grip.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

Angled Grip.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Reduces translational recoil by 30%
Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
7.5% faster sprint transition speeds
Increases gun kick by 10%
Reduces aiming walkspeed by 10%
Reduces aiming and equip speeds by 5%

Vertical Grip.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

[GAIN]
- -8% Rotation X recoil.
- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-30% Walk sway.
+10% Sprint transition speeds.

[LOSS]
- +12% Camera Body horizontal (Y) recoil.
-5% aim/equip speed.

infolist: Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.
Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.
Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

Skeleton Grip.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

15% improved gun sway
10% faster aiming speeds
15% faster sprint transition time
10% faster equip & unequip speeds
10% slower walkspeed while aiming
Slightly improved vertical gun kick
Slightly worse horizontal recoil variance

infolist: Decreased weapon rotation and translation recoil.
Slightly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

Handstop.info:
A low-profile handstop to help you maintain a stable firing position.

Lowers rearward kick by 25%, reduces rearward kick variance by 55%
Slightly improves horizontal and vertical translational recoil and kick
Slightly increases vertical and horizontal variance
10% faster sprint speeds
15% faster aim time
3% better aiming walkspeed
10% lower weapon sway when aiming down sights or scoped in

Blue Laser.info:
A tactical blue laser designed to improve target acquisition speeds.

Improves aiming speed by 7%.

infolist: Decreased camera body YZ recoil and variance.
Slightly decreased weapon rotation look sway.
Slightly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.
Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

Yellow Laser.info: A yellow-colored laser with a built-in IR illuminator. Improves weapon equip & unequip speeds, and slightly improves weapon sway.

Tri Laser.info:
A triple laser pointer.
Improves hipfire damping and decreases your crosshair size & spread rate.

Pistol Grip.info:
A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

20% less vertical rotational recoil.
8% less gun kick
10% less muzzle climb
15% less gun sway
10% better hipfire stability
10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

Laser.info:
A red colored laser pointer.
Improves your gun transition speed when you start and stop sprinting.

Tracerless.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

Extended Magazine.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

.223 Remington.info:
Civilian version of the 5.56x45mm NATO military round.

Reduces recoil at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and a little bit of penetration and suppression.
Also slightly boosts aim speed!

Decreases camera recoil.
+2.5% Aiming speed.
-7% Min damage.
-25% Max range.
-8% Penetration and Suppression.

Armor Piercing.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

Hollow Point.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
